comments: Merged UI+backend slices where appropriate for cohesive features
Added error handling slices for each major operation
Added observability, logging, and admin features
Standardized naming to verb-first, present tense
Ensured dependencies only reference existing slices

slices.description: Create Prisma schema with Project and Estimate entities for multi-tenant estimation storage.

source.userStory: As a developer I need the database schema to store projects and estimates
source.acceptanceCriteria: Prisma migrations created and applied successfully

slices.description: Set up row-level security and tenant isolation in database and API layer.

source.userStory: As a user I can only see my organization's data
source.acceptanceCriteria: queries filter by tenant ID from auth context

slices.description: Show all projects for the authenticated user's tenant with filtering and sorting.

source.userStory: As a user I can see all my projects
source.acceptanceCriteria: returns list of projects filtered by tenant with name and creation date

slices.description: Display appropriate error states and retry options when project listing fails.

source.userStory: As a user I understand what went wrong when errors occur
source.acceptanceCriteria: displays clear, actionable error messages

slices.description: Create new project container with name, description, and tenant association.

source.userStory: As a user I can create a new project
source.acceptanceCriteria: returns 201 with new project ID and redirects to project page

slices.description: Validate project inputs and display clear error messages when creation fails.

source.userStory: As a user I understand what went wrong when errors occur
source.acceptanceCriteria: displays clear, actionable error messages

slices.description: Upload, validate, and parse CSV files into structured JSON with progress indication.

source.userStory: As a user I can upload a CSV file from DevReady
source.acceptanceCriteria: parses CSV and returns structured JSON with modules, stories, and tasks

source.userStory: As a user I get clear error messages for invalid CSV files
source.acceptanceCriteria: returns 400 with specific validation errors for malformed CSV

source.userStory: As a user I get feedback when uploading large files
source.acceptanceCriteria: shows progress bar and enforces 10MB file size limit

slices.description: Show detailed validation errors and recovery options when CSV parsing fails.

source.userStory: As a user I get clear error messages for invalid CSV files
source.acceptanceCriteria: returns 400 with specific validation errors for malformed CSV

slices.description: Create initial estimate version from CSV with default rate card and calculations.

source.userStory: As a user I can upload a CSV to create an initial estimate
source.acceptanceCriteria: creates estimate v1 with parsed data and default rate card

source.userStory: As a user I get default rates applied to my estimate
source.acceptanceCriteria: extracts unique role/region pairs and assigns default rates

source.userStory: As a user I can see calculated totals immediately after upload
source.acceptanceCriteria: displays accurate total hours, cost, and price with default margin

slices.description: Show estimate with summary metrics, module breakdown, and collapsible sections.

source.userStory: As a user I can see the estimate summary
source.acceptanceCriteria: displays totals prominently with margin percentage

source.userStory: As a user I can see the detailed task breakdown
source.acceptanceCriteria: displays hierarchical view of modules, stories, and tasks with hours

source.userStory: As a user I can expand/collapse modules for easier viewing
source.acceptanceCriteria: toggles module visibility and shows subtotals

source.userStory: As a user I can see key metrics at a glance
source.acceptanceCriteria: displays hours, cost, price, and editable margin

slices.description: Edit existing rates and add new role/region combinations with instant recalculation.

source.userStory: As a user I can adjust hourly rates
source.acceptanceCriteria: updates rates and recalculates totals in real-time

source.userStory: As a user I can add custom role/region rates
source.acceptanceCriteria: adds new rate entry and applies to matching tasks

source.userStory: As a user I can easily edit rates in a table format
source.acceptanceCriteria: shows role, region, rate with inline editing

slices.description: Edit individual task hours with inline validation and immediate recalculation.

source.userStory: As a user I can adjust task hours
source.acceptanceCriteria: updates hours and recalculates totals in real-time

slices.description: Change margin percentage with validation and immediate price recalculation.

source.userStory: As a user I can adjust the margin percentage
source.acceptanceCriteria: updates margin and recalculates total price in real-time

slices.description: Enforce validation rules across all numeric inputs with immediate feedback.

source.userStory: As a user I cannot enter invalid numeric values
source.acceptanceCriteria: prevents non-numeric input and shows validation errors

slices.description: Perform client-side calculation of all totals when any value changes.

source.userStory: As a user I see instant updates when I change values
source.acceptanceCriteria: totals update immediately without server round-trip

slices.description: Save current state as new version with incremented number and optional note.

source.userStory: As a user I can save my changes as a new version
source.acceptanceCriteria: creates new version with all current values and optional note

source.userStory: As a user I can add a note describing what changed
source.acceptanceCriteria: saves note with version for future reference

slices.description: Provide error handling, retry logic, and local backup for version save failures.

source.userStory: As a user I understand what went wrong when errors occur
source.acceptanceCriteria: displays clear, actionable error messages

slices.description: List, select, and load previous estimate versions with complete history.

source.userStory: As a user I can see all versions of an estimate
source.acceptanceCriteria: shows version number, date, creator, and note in dropdown

source.userStory: As a user I can switch to view any previous version
source.acceptanceCriteria: loads complete estimate state including rates and values

source.userStory: As a user I can navigate between projects and versions
source.acceptanceCriteria: shows current project, version dropdown, save button

slices.description: Gracefully handle and recover from version loading failures.

source.userStory: As a user I understand what went wrong when errors occur
source.acceptanceCriteria: displays clear, actionable error messages

slices.description: Record all user actions for audit, troubleshooting, and analytics.

source.userStory: As an admin I can track user activity
source.acceptanceCriteria: logs all create, edit, and save actions with timestamps and user IDs

slices.description: Apply rate limits to all API endpoints to prevent abuse.

source.userStory: As a system operator I want to prevent API abuse
source.acceptanceCriteria: limits request frequency and returns 429 errors when exceeded

slices.description: Build admin view showing all projects, versions, and system metrics.

source.userStory: As an admin I can monitor system usage
source.acceptanceCriteria: displays project counts, version counts, and user activity

slices.description: Allow admins to view any project, troubleshoot errors, and retry operations.

source.userStory: As an admin I can help users with issues
source.acceptanceCriteria: provides admin override for access, retry, and diagnostics
